lines.text: Moses and Aaron ask Pharaoh to let the people go on a three-day journey into the wilderness to sacrifice.
Pharaoh stops the straw for bricks, keeps the same quota, and calls the people lazy.
The people scatter across the wilderness to gather stubble for straw, and the Israelite foremen are beaten.
The foremen appeal to Pharaoh, who calls them slackers, and then tell Moses and Hur they have made them a stench.
Moses asks the LORD why He brought trouble on the people, and the LORD says Pharaoh will drive them out.
